data: Amazon reported a **net loss of $2,722 million in fiscal 2022** and **net income of $59,248 million in fiscal 2024**, according to its fiscal 2024 Form 10-K. That is an improvement of $61,970 million. Because the starting year was a loss, a conventional percentage change is not strictly meaningful. Measured against the absolute value of the 2022 loss, the swing works out to roughly 2,277%. It is more informative to describe this as a turnaround from loss to profit. Fiscal 2023 net income of $30,425 million sat between the two, and 2024 net income was about 95% higher than 2023. Much of the 2022 loss came from $16,806 million of other non-operating expense, which the filing's cash flow statement records under non-operating expense. Operating income rose from $12,248 million in 2022 to $68,593 million in 2024.
